Globally Trusted partner

Advancing Scientific
Innovation Worldwide

Advancing Scientific Innovation Worldwide

A trailblazer in the development of vivarium technologies, solutions, and services supporting research in 43+ countries for two decades Explore Solutions our mission and vision

Built on Purpose, Driven by Vision

Our Story

Founded over 20 years ago, our company began with a simple mission: to make cutting-edge scientific equipment accessible to researchers worldwide. What started as a small distribution operation has grown into a global network spanning 43 countries  Today, we're proud to serve over 500 customers, from university research labs to pharmaceutical companies, providing them with the tools they need to push the boundaries of scientific discovery

Our Mission

We create safe, sterile, and enriched environments for research animals, supporting scientific progress while prioritizing animal and human welfare Through advanced vivarium services and our Research-Ready disposable IVC System, we streamline operations, reduce resource use, and minimize animal stress. Everything we do is focused on making research more efficient, sustainable, and respectful of life Leadership

Why Join Innovive

At Innovive, you’re not just building a career you’re contributing to a mission that advances scientific discovery while prioritizing sustainability and ethical practices. Our work directly supports the global research community, helping create safer, more efficient environments for both people and animalsWhat You Can Expect
  • Purpose-Driven Work
  • Be part of solutions that improve research outcomes and promote responsible science
  • Innovation at the Core
  • Work with forward-thinking technologies that are transforming vivarium operations
  • Global Impact
  • Collaborate with teams and partners across the world
  • Growth & Development
  • Opportunities to learn, grow, and advance your career
  • Supportive Culture
  • A team that values respect, collaboration, and shared success
LEADERSHIP

Trusted By Leading Research Companies

Meet the experts driving innovation and supporting research worldwide our mission and vision

Four beliefs that shape every decision

Biocontainment

Every vivarium technology is engineered to meet the exacting standards of the researchers who rely on them

Collaboration & Innovation

From Seoul to São Paulo — a network built to support science wherever it happens

Aseptic Setup

Two decades of refinement, iterated alongside the world's leading research institutions

Efficiency & Scalability

Two decades of refinement, iterated alongside the world's leading research institutions

Sustainability

  • Already has strong data (50% HVAC reduction, 70% carbon footprint reduction)
  • Needs a narrative arc, not just a feature list
  • Dark callout section for the environmental mission statement
  • Ties back to Research-Ready (the sustainability angle of the three pillars)
Explore More
